message: A repeating task can now add a one-off task every few times you complete it: rosin the bow every 4th violin practice, change the filter every 6th time you run the extractor. Set "Follow-up task" in the task editor: pick how often and name the task to add, and it turns up due with the next occurrence. It's in a new Relationships section, alongside "Waiting on", which used to be buried in Schedule
